_readme: Guardrail lists for the content check (pnpm lint:content). Anyone can edit this file: add a word or phrase to a list and the check enforces it in every language file.

How matching works: case, accents of the same letter (full-width letters, nukta dots in Hindi), invisible characters and punctuation inside a word are ignored, and a space in an entry also matches no space. So 'paytm' also catches 'Pay-tm' and 'PAYTM', 'sbi' catches 'S.B.I.', and 'phone pe' catches 'PhonePe'. Entries match whole words only, so 'cred' does not match 'credit'.
brands: real banks, apps, funds, schemes and products. Never allowed anywhere (error). Add the Hindi spelling next to the English one.
promises: guarantees and pushy advice. Error everywhere except inside a Scam or Safe? message body, which may quote a scammer on purpose.
shaming: words that shame people. Only a warning.
investingTerms: real product words not allowed on investing cards, which may only use the fictionalAssets.
allowedLinks: the only websites content may show. A sub-site (www.cybercrime.gov.in) is fine; a look-alike (cybercrime.gov.in.evil.com) is not.
allowedNumbers: the only phone or helpline numbers content may show.

scamPlaceholderDomains and scamPlaceholderNumbers: clearly fake links and numbers that Scam or Safe? message bodies may use. 'example', 'invalid' and 'test' are reserved names that never reach a real website.
maxDelayWeeks: a delayed effect must land within the 12-week game.
lengthCaps: the most visible characters a text may have, in every language. See packages/content/README.md for which keys use which cap.
